# AnuPpuccin

AnuPpuccin recolours Obsidian's in-app variables rather than overriding the interface piecemeal, which its recorded description ties to compatibility with custom snippets. Its configuration lives in the Style Settings plugin, and leaving the options off keeps a look close to the vanilla one.

![AnuPpuccin screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anubisnekhet/AnuPpuccin/HEAD/preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "AnuPpuccin"
    author: "anubisnekhet"
    repo:   "anubisnekhet/AnuPpuccin"
    slug:   "anuppuccin"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/anuppuccin"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/anubisnekhet/AnuPpuccin"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anubisnekhet/AnuPpuccin/HEAD/preview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply AnuPpuccin for a personal, configurable Obsidian appearance that recolors in-app variables for compatibility with custom snippets. Customize via the Style Settings plugin for full control, or keep the vanilla look by leaving options off."
}
```
